title: Model, agent or harness? 3 cases to stop calling it all “the AI”
source: SANTISMM Labs, “¿Modelo, agente o arnés?” (labs.santismm.com/model-agent-harness, read 18-11-2026) · santismm.com/en/harness-engineering

scenes.text: We call all of it “the AI,” but it's three layers: can you tell them apart?
The model, the capability that predicts and generates; the agent, the entity that perceives, decides and acts; the harness, the system that connects context and tools.
Case one: Codex gets a task, edits files and runs tests until it's done.
Agent: there's a goal, decisions and actions, and it uses a model inside a harness.
A layer limits permissions, logs traces and cuts off high-impact actions.
Harness: it governs how the model or the agent is used.
Claude Sonnet with no memory, no tools and no outer loop.
Model: with nothing that lets it act, it's still just a model.
So when something fails or improves, don't blame or praise “the AI.” Ask: model, agent or harness?
Save it, and share it with someone who still calls it all “the AI.”
